resources.string: Weather uses the internet: it asks Open-Meteo for the forecast. Turn it on?
Search uses the internet: it asks DuckDuckGo. Turn it on?
The lyrics skill uses the internet: it asks Genius. Turn it on?
Translation uses the internet: it asks Lingva. Turn it on?
The joke skill uses the internet: it asks the Official Joke API. Turn it on?

It sends the place you name, or your default city, to Open-Meteo to find it, then its coordinates rounded to about 1 km. When you choose your location, only those rounded coordinates. While Breezy Weather shares a fresh forecast with GAR, GAR answers from it without the internet.
It sends what you search for to DuckDuckGo.
It sends the song you name to Genius.
It sends the text to translate to Lingva (lingva.ml), which gets the translation from Google Translate. With Offline Translator on the phone, GAR translates there instead, without the internet.
It gets a random joke from official-joke-api.appspot.com, or from JokeAPI (v2.jokeapi.dev) in other languages. Nothing you say is sent.
